scope: Additive official-gamebook reconciliation for NE-CHI. The official gamebook corrects the earlier provisional 27-21 record to Chicago 30, New England 24 and completes the paired starter, substitute, DNP, inactive, quarterback, specialist and printed in-game-injury inventory. It preserves supported prior case work and identifies the remaining numerical assembly and method decisions without applying learning, updating ratings, altering a fair, publishing a new customer number or issuing a bet.

sources.finding: The Patriots official game page reports FINAL with New England 24 and Chicago 30. This authoritative result supersedes the earlier provisional 21-27 record.
The Patriots published the official Week 7 gamebook article on October 22, 2026 and linked the final gamebook PDF.

The official 17-page gamebook reports Chicago 30, New England 24; lists every starter, substitute, DNP and inactive; records all quarterback and specialist production; and prints injury/return events for Kevin Byard, Nahshon Muhammad, Cole Kmet and Christian Barmore.
The bound pregame record supplies the complete paired reserve, final-inactive and elevation inventory reused additively here.

EA SPORTS' current Madden NFL 27 player page identifies Nikola Kalinic as a tight end with 58 OVR. This makes the already approved source-supported estimate method available for the Week 7 case without changing the frozen registry.
